card.name: Punctuation just before a digit
card.fires_on: A decimal point or hyphen sitting between two digits or between a name and a number, right before the next digit. Typical cases are the point in 37.5 mg and the hyphen in COX-2.

modes.label: Decimal point in doses
modes.description: The period inside a number with a decimal part, such as a dose or weight, just before the final digit.
modes.example: The recommended starting dose is 37<<.>>5 mg per day of venlaf
